Hi Jessica — thanks for the redline. I attached a short comment set and a marked PDF (redwood_dpa_comments_20251027.pdf) with suggested language. Quick notes:

- HSM/KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keying via KMS integrations and can restrict access such that internal services cannot decrypt at rest without a customer-kept key. For customers requiring physical HSM attestation on-prem, we offer Private deployment options (we can include an addendum describing KMS/HSM controls).

- Subprocessors: the attached CSV is our current subprocessor list. We confirm that for our hosted SaaS tier, subprocessors process data on our behalf; however, certain telemetry and aggregated metrics are processed by vendor analytics platforms — we can include contractual limits to ensure no raw customer content is used for training or model improvement without consent. We can provide an attestation letter post-signature; if you need pre-signature attestation, let us know and we'll expedite.

- Transfers: we can include the latest EU SCC addendum. We'll append the SCCs as a schedule; Redwood will act as data processor per the clauses.

- E-sign: DocuSign is our default and most automated path; Redwood will ensure the executed envelope contains the exact PDF you approve. If AdobeSign is required, we will accept that workflow but need the Adobe account name for envelope verification.

Suggested timeline: you return a cleaned PDF of the redline by next Tue (2025-11-03), we aim for final signatures by 2025-11-10 assuming no further commercial changes. If procurement needs PO/Net terms, please include now so Ben can coordinate.
